name: Mysterious Relic
summary: The Mysterious Relic is an unfamiliar device found during a naga excavation on the Isle of Dread. Feathermoon Stronghold wants it studied to learn what it is.

sections.title: A Strange Find
sections.body:
Scouts traced Lord Shalzaru’s excavation to a cave south of the main ruins on the Isle of Dread. The naga lord uncovered the Mysterious Relic there, and Latronicus Moonspear asked that it be brought to Feathermoon Stronghold for study.

Latronicus could make little of the device, so he sent it to his wife Vestia, a priestess and scholar. She found it unlike the ruins’ usual objects and unlike naga work. Its nature remains uncertain while she studies it.

faq.q: Where was the Mysterious Relic found?
faq.answer: Lord Shalzaru uncovered the Mysterious Relic in a naga excavation cave south of the main ruins on the Isle of Dread.
Latronicus Moonspear asked for the Mysterious Relic to be brought to Feathermoon Stronghold so it could be studied.
Vestia Moonspear, Latronicus’s wife and a priestess and scholar, studies the Mysterious Relic.
Vestia says the Mysterious Relic is unlike the objects of the Ruins of Solarsal and is not of naga design. She needs time to study it.

faq.q: Did the naga make the relic?
faq.answer: Vestia says the Mysterious Relic is not of naga design, though its maker remains unknown.
